norma-amezcua.text: Per her NLMUSD board bio, she joined the board because she believes 'all children deserve a quality education regardless of their socio-economic status' and that engaging parents supports academic success. She directs early learning centers for the Mexican American Opportunity Foundation.

source.title: Norwalk-La Mirada USD: Board Member Norma Amezcua bio

marybel-micaela-lorenzo.text: Will work to make class sizes small, 'because a teacher who knows your child can change your child's life,' and push for stronger academic programs and support for students with special needs.

source.title: Marybel Lorenzo for Norwalk-La Mirada School Board: My Priorities

marybel-micaela-lorenzo.text: Says families too often learn of board decisions after the vote; will insist parents are told first, costs are published plainly, and 'no major decision moves without true public discussion. No more rubber stamps.'

source.title: Marybel Lorenzo for Norwalk-La Mirada School Board: My Priorities

marybel-micaela-lorenzo.text: Pledges to 'fight for the staffing, support, and working conditions that allow our educators to give every student the attention they deserve.'

source.title: Marybel Lorenzo for Norwalk-La Mirada School Board: My Priorities
